note: T2 Brainstorm with Island as the land and no fetch to shuffle: put back Veil and City, then drew the known City on t4. The better line was Ponder on t2 (it can shuffle) and Brainstorm on t4 with Misty to crack. Small cost, but the 'weave the fetch' rule applied.

Passed Force of Will (Brainstorm, Ponder or Show and Tell as the pitch) on the t3 Spider-Woman, which later made Atraxa and Petal enter tapped. The Force was kept, and it countered the Raptor-discovered Goblin Bombardment on t5, which would otherwise have been lethal on t7. Is passing on Spider-Woman right in general against Boros?

T6 Show and Tell for Atraxa into an untapped Spider-Woman (Atraxa enters tapped and cannot block a 9-power board) with A at 13, versus waiting. The reveal of Omniscience, Petal, Ponder, Atraxa and Misty set up the t8 win at 4 life. Is Atraxa-as-card-draw the right framing under Spider-Woman?

T6 land drop: Boseiju (no life) over Ancient Tomb (2 life, 1 spare mana after Show and Tell) with A at 13 facing a wide Boros board. A ended at 4, so the 2 life mattered; the spare mana had no use (the Petal from the reveal entered tapped).

Erode on a tapped, summoning-sick Atraxa while Karakas was untapped and can bounce a legendary Atraxa for free at instant speed. B knew A held Omniscience and a second Atraxa; holding Erode for the Acererak trigger was the only out on A's kill turn (A's free Atraxa then found Force, so it likely would not have mattered).
